comments.text: The check circles are hard to hit with a thumb, and I keep opening the plant instead of ticking it off. Can the watering button be much bigger?
comments.author: jordan

comments.text: I didn't notice the streak until my third visit. It's the nicest thing on this screen, so make it something you see at a glance, not a grey caption.
comments.author: riley

comments.text: The orange "Thirsty" label is too light on the cream cards. It fails contrast, and it's the one word on this screen I need to read.
comments.author: jordan

comments.text: Seven badges and a paragraph before anything I can act on. When I open Monty I want to know when to water next.
comments.author: riley

comments.text: I can see moisture drop and jump back, but not which jumps were me watering. Could the chart mark each watering?
comments.author: jordan

comments.text: Could we add a dark theme toggle here?
comments.author: riley

replies.text: Agree. The grey also fails contrast on the cream background.
replies.author: jordan

replies.text: Yes please. A small drop above each jump would do it.
replies.author: riley

replies.text: In v2 each task has a 52 px watering button with a drop icon, so it reads as the action and is easy to hit.
replies.author: riley

replies.text: The streak is now a row of the last seven days in full contrast. Today's dot fills in when everything is done.
replies.author: riley

replies.text: Thirsty is now dark terracotta with a drop, about 6:1 against the card (it was about 2:1).
replies.author: riley

replies.text: The header now shows the plant, its kind and room, and when to water. Light, humidity, pets and age moved to a Care list below the chart.
replies.author: riley

replies.text: Each watering now has a drop above its jump, with a small legend.
replies.author: riley

replies.text: Not this round: Sprout will follow the system theme once the visual design settles, so a separate toggle isn't needed yet.
replies.author: riley
